einzeiler: Three essential questions to ask yourself before launching a physical product business.
kurzfassung: Kimberly explores the decision to expand a coaching and podcast business by launching an online gift boutique. She outlines three vital questions entrepreneurs must consider regarding passion, customer fit, and logistical challenges. The discussion emphasizes thoughtful planning over impulsive trend-chasing when adding physical goods.
stichpunkte: Expanding a coaching brand with an online boutique featuring guided journals and desk items
Distinguishing between genuine business growth and a temporary rush of excitement
Evaluating whether selling physical merchandise aligns with personal interests and long-term goals
Assessing if target customers are truly willing to pay for the proposed products
Navigating the logistical realities of website management, inventory, and customer service
Utilizing third-party fulfillment centers and print-on-demand services to maintain a hands-off operation
Planning future content focused on product businesses to guide aspiring entrepreneurs

kapitel.titel: A Journal Idea Becomes A Shop
Test One: Does This Sound Fun
Test Two: Fit For You And Them
Wrap Up And How To Get Help

clips.hook: Is that excitement genuine passion or just a temporary chemical rush?
clips.text: Brainstorming new concepts often triggers a powerful wave of physical excitement and elevated hormone levels that can easily be mistaken for a solid business strategy.

clips.hook: Developing a custom guided journal takes months of dedicated work.
clips.text: Spent several months creating a personalized journal designed to help individuals build businesses aligned with their authentic selves.

clips.hook: Not every service provider wants to deal with returns and inventory.
clips.text: Service-oriented professionals often prefer to avoid the constant burden of managing product inventory, manufacturing, and customer returns.

clips.hook: Running a boutique from home with three young kids was chaotic.
clips.text: Managing early e-commerce operations from a residential address involved daily visits from delivery drivers, printing labels at home, and packing boxes.

clips.hook: Planning ahead for retirement and travel while automating fulfillment.
clips.text: Preparing for upcoming lifestyle changes by utilizing third-party storage and manufacturing partners to avoid spending hours on manual shipping tasks.

beschreibung:
Thinking about adding physical products to your business? Before you order inventory or open a Shopify store, there are three questions you need to answer honestly, and most people skip straight past the first one.
In this episode Kimberly shares the news that she's adding an online gift boutique to She's Just Getting Started, and walks you through the exact decision process she used to get there.
She's been in the product world since 2003, when she launched her first online boutique and ran two stores until 2019. So this is not theory. She gets into the part nobody warns you about, and how she's structuring this new boutique so she barely touches a box.
The boutique opens September 14 for early birds and September 16 for everyone else. Gifts for the woman who's starting or building something, and for everyone cheering her on.
